proof_body:
by
  intro a b hab f f' f'' h1 h2 hc hper x
  haveI hT : Fact (0 < b - a) := ⟨sub_pos.mpr hab⟩
  have hba : 0 < b - a := sub_pos.mpr hab
  have hper' : Function.Periodic f (b - a) := hper
  have hper1 : ∀ y, f' (y + (b - a)) = f' y := by
    intro y
    have h3 := (h1 (y + (b - a))).comp_add_const y (b - a)
    have h4 : (fun z => f (z + (b - a))) = f := funext hper
    rw [h4] at h3
    exact h3.unique (h1 y)
  have hfa : f a = f b := by
    have := hper a; rw [show a + (b - a) = b by ring] at this; exact this.symm
  have hf'a : f' a = f' b := by
    have := hper1 a; rw [show a + (b - a) = b by ring] at this; exact this.symm
  have hi'' : IntervalIntegrable f'' MeasureTheory.volume a b := hc.intervalIntegrable a b
  have hc' : Continuous f' := continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr (fun y => (h2 y).continuousAt)
  have hi' : IntervalIntegrable f' MeasureTheory.volume a b := hc'.intervalIntegrable a b
  have hfc : Continuous f := continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr (fun y => (h1 y).continuousAt)
  let F : C(AddCircle (b - a), ℂ) := ⟨hper'.lift, continuous_coinduced_dom.mpr hfc⟩
  have hF : ∀ y : ℝ, F (y : AddCircle (b - a)) = f y := fun y => rfl
  have hcoef : ∀ n : ℤ, fourierCoeff (F : AddCircle (b - a) → ℂ) n = fourierCoeffOn hab f n := by
    intro n
    rw [fourierCoeff_eq_intervalIntegral _ n a, fourierCoeffOn_eq_integral, show a + (b - a) = b by ring]
    simp only [hF]
  set M : ℝ := (b - a)⁻¹ * ∫ y in a..b, ‖f'' y‖ with hM
  have hbound : ∀ n : ℤ, ‖fourierCoeffOn hab f'' n‖ ≤ M := by
    intro n
    rw [fourierCoeffOn_eq_integral, norm_smul]
    have h1 : ‖∫ y in a..b, fourier (-n) (y : AddCircle (b - a)) • f'' y‖ ≤ ∫ y in a..b, ‖f'' y‖ := by
      refine (intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_integral_norm hab.le).trans (le_of_eq ?_)
      congr 1
      funext y
      rw [norm_smul, fourier_apply, Circle.norm_coe, one_mul]
    have h2 : ‖((1 / (b - a) : ℝ))‖ = (b - a)⁻¹ := by
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (by positivity), one_div]
    rw [h2]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (by positivity)
  have hdecay : ∀ n : ℤ, n ≠ 0 → ‖fourierCoeffOn hab f n‖ ≤ ((b - a) / (2 * Real.pi)) ^ 2 * M * (1 / (n : ℝ) ^ 2) := by
    intro n hn
    have e1 := fourierCoeffOn_of_hasDerivAt hab hn (fun y _ => h1 y) hi'
    have e2 := fourierCoeffOn_of_hasDerivAt hab hn (fun y _ => h2 y) hi''
    rw [← hfa, sub_self, mul_zero, zero_sub] at e1
    rw [← hf'a, sub_self, mul_zero, zero_sub] at e2
    rw [e2] at e1
    rw [e1]
    have hn' : (0:ℝ) < |(n:ℝ)| := abs_pos.mpr (by exact_mod_cast hn)
    have h4 : ‖(b : ℂ) - a‖ = b - a := by
      rw [← Complex.ofReal_sub, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hba]
    have h3 : ‖(1 : ℂ) / (-2 * Real.pi * Complex.I * n)‖ = 1 / (2 * Real.pi * |(n : ℝ)|) := by
      simp [abs_of_pos Real.pi_pos]
    simp only [norm_mul, norm_neg, h3, h4]
    have hsq : (n:ℝ) ^ 2 = |(n:ℝ)| ^ 2 := (sq_abs _).symm
    rw [hsq]
    have hb := hbound n
    calc _ ≤ 1 / (2 * Real.pi * |(n : ℝ)|) * ((b - a) * (1 / (2 * Real.pi * |(n : ℝ)|) * ((b - a) * M))) := by gcongr
      _ = _ := by field_simp
  have hsum : Summable (fourierCoeff (F : AddCircle (b - a) → ℂ)) := by
    have hg : Summable (fun n : ℤ => ((b - a) / (2 * Real.pi)) ^ 2 * M * (1 / (n : ℝ) ^ 2)) :=
      (Real.summable_one_div_int_pow.mpr (by norm_num)).mul_left _
    refine Summable.of_norm_bounded_eventually hg ?_
    have hfin : ({0} : Set ℤ).Finite := Set.finite_singleton 0
    filter_upwards [hfin.compl_mem_cofinite] with n hn
    rw [hcoef]
    exact hdecay n hn
  have hp := has_pointwise_sum_fourier_series_of_summable hsum (x : AddCircle (b - a))
  rw [hF] at hp
  refine HasSum.congr_fun hp (fun n => ?_)
  rw [hcoef, fourier_coe_apply, smul_eq_mul]
target_source: ∀ (a b : ℝ) (hab : a < b) (f f' f'' : ℝ → ℂ), (∀ x, HasDerivAt f (f' x) x) → (∀ x, HasDerivAt f' (f'' x) x) → Continuous f'' → (∀ x, f (x + (b - a)) = f x) → ∀ x : ℝ, HasSum (fun n : ℤ => fourierCoeffOn hab f n * Complex.exp (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I * n * x / ((b - a : ℝ) : ℂ))) (f x)
